# Robsi

Robsi applies a Material Design 3 look with purple accents and frosted blur on sidebars and modals. The layout is compact and responsive, with smooth animations, multi-level list markers and extensive Style Settings customization across light and dark modes.

![Robsi screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/riffaells/Robsi/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Robsi"
    author: "riffaells"
    repo:   "riffaells/Robsi"
    slug:   "robsi"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/robsi"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/riffaells/Robsi"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/riffaells/Robsi/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a modern Material Design 3 look with purple accents and frosted blur effects on sidebars and modals. Use a compact, responsive layout with smooth animations, beautiful multi-level list markers, and extensive Style Settings customization for light and dark modes."
}
```
